protocolAuthority.role: official Meta Messenger Platform protocol and webhook security semantics

graphSchemaAuthority.role: official Meta generated Graph Page schema authority for supported subscribed_fields including message_echoes and message_reactions

behaviorAuthority.role: mature Facebook Page channel behavior, event parsing, subscription and conversation ownership reference

businessAssetReference.role: Meta business asset, OAuth, token and webhook operational reference
businessAssetReference.runtimeLimitation: not a Facebook Page Messenger runtime; current messaging implementation is WhatsApp-focused

yanceBoundary.canonicalBusinessAuthority: Yance Core canonical identity, conversation, message, ledger and outbox
yanceBoundary.workerRole: bounded secret, webhook, media and delivery edge only; not protocol or business-state authority
forbidden: new Yance-owned Messenger protocol semantics without a new OSS-fit review

modeSeparation.facebookPersonal: frozen separate mautrix/meta authority; not reused by Facebook Public
modeSeparation.instagramProfessional: separate permission and webhook contract even when infrastructure is shared
